name: Southern Score Builders Berhad
summary: Southern Score Builders Berhad, an investment holding company, provides construction management services for building and infrastructure works in Malaysia. It offers digital engineering advisory, construction advisory, and building information modelling services. The company also engages in the retail sale of construction materials, hardware, paints, and glasses; mechanical and electrical works; and information technology research and development business.
